_comment: Pip animation rig - single place to edit shared motion parameters.
Coordinates are WORKING GRID CELLS on the 128x192 canvas (1 cell = 6 native px of pip.png).
Edit here, then re-run:  python layers.py && python build.py
Timelines for the 32 animations live in motions.py.

grid.ground_note: soles sit on this row; feet anchor here

pivots.neck_note: center of the visible gray neck bolt - head rotation pivot
pivots.tail_note: where the tail emerges from the torso

cuts.head_note: head = rows < 109, plus rows 109-110 for x 52..92 (the jaw overhang next to the neck; the tail tip lives at x 101-112 and must stay in the tail)
cuts.gray_zone_note: only the neck bolt may quantize to gray (kills antialias speckle elsewhere)
cuts.neck_filler_note: dark underlay behind the head so the neck seam never opens during chin poses; kept clear of the gray bolt and inside the neutral silhouette
cuts.tail_note: rows 110-135 = swinging band right of tail_left_by_row; rows 136-150 = fill-only root shared with the hip
cuts.arm_note: root rows are duplicated into the body so the arm never leaves a hole

eyes.eye_note: mint shape is cut from the source; pupil+catchlight are rebuilt clean and always move together
eyes.viewer_note: 'toward the viewer' = pupils converge 2 cells (L eye +2, R eye -2)

mouth.mouth_note: C=closed(thin seam) R=resting(the source smile) S=slightly open; the tooth is redrawn in every shape

head_pose_note: Reusable head poses (yaw turn, pitch nod, roll tilt).
turn_L/turn_R squeeze or stretch the projected snout (columns >= snout_x0) and
change how much of the far eye (eye R) shows; chin_up/chin_down shear the head
by row zones so the snout dips/lifts and the neck exposure changes; tilt is the
sideways roll (head_rot) kept for listening so it never reads as a turn.
zone rows are shifted as whole rows with seam fill - never a flat cutout.

turn_R.label: turn toward screen-right (a little more profile)

chin_up.label: chin up (snout lifts away from the chest, more neck shows)

chin_down.label: chin down (snout dips toward the chest, less neck shows)
